facts.fact: Togo's revenue office states that Togo signed a memorandum of understanding with the Confederation of Sahel States on interconnecting customs IT systems on 23 July 2024 in Niamey.
facts.system: Protocole d'accord relatif a l'interconnexion des systemes informatiques des administrations douanieres (AES and Togo)

facts.fact: Togo's Office Togolais des Recettes issued notice 004/2025 of 6 March 2025 applying that protocol, stating the pilot interconnection of Togo and Mali customs systems via Burkina Faso on the Lome-Bamako corridor operates from 10 March 2025.
